name: A Positive 292-Concept Path Expansion with No Horizontal USO Lift
definition: Let $A$ be the certified 289-concept rooted factor with unique corner $0$, take the path reduction $D=\{0,2,4\}$, and form either component expansion $(A\times\{0\})\cup(D\times\{1\})$ or its reflection in the fresh coordinate.
parameters: Each expansion has $292$ concepts. The complement $A\setminus D$ is connected, so these are the only two component labelings.
properties: Every acyclic USO of $A$ has unique source $0$ and directs both edges of $D$ away from its middle vertex, so its restriction to $D$ is not a USO and no acyclic USO of either expansion can preserve all horizontal directions from a contraction USO. Nevertheless both expansions are corner-peelable: delete the two upper leaves, then the upper middle vertex, and follow the recorded peeling of $A$.
